_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Through the Pipes#001.src: You're a lifesaver, {u}. I cannot thank you enough!
Through the Pipes#001.dst: Me has salvado la vida, {u}. ¡No sé cómo agradecértelo!

Through the Pipes#002.src: WAIT! MY ART BAG IS MISSING! Did I accidentally drop it somewhere?
Through the Pipes#002.dst: ¡ESPERA! ¡MI BOLSA DE PINTURAS NO ESTÁ! ¿La habré dejado caer por ahí?

Through the Pipes#003.src: Do you want us to sink?!

similar.text: So you want us to sneak in?

Through the Pipes#004.src: What's your name... {u}? Great, I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#004.dst: ¿Cómo te llamas... {u}? Genial, yo también seguiré buscando a ese bobo. ¡Mucha suerte!

Through the Pipes#006.src: Maybe it's best to continue forward...

Through the Pipes#008.src: You hear someone in the distance.
Through the Pipes#008.dst: Oyes a alguien a lo lejos.

Through the Pipes#009.src: I'm so glad you found it! I don't know what I would do if I lost Soosu's gift and my bag!
Through the Pipes#009.dst: ¡Cuánto me alegro de que la encontraras! ¡No sé qué haría si perdiera el regalo de Soosu y mi bolsa!

Through the Pipes#010.src: You are? Excellent! Let's see what you've created.

Through the Pipes#012.src: Are you sure you want to leave the dock?

Through the Pipes#014.dst: El generador cobra vida con un zumbido.

Through the Pipes#015.src: You pull the hook off of the grapple. It might be useful later.
Through the Pipes#015.dst: Arrancas el gancho del garfio. Quizá sirva más adelante.

Through the Pipes#017.src: You must be on your raft to use this.
Through the Pipes#017.dst: Debes estar en tu balsa para usar esto.

Through the Pipes#018.src: Find a way to open that gate. I don't want to be on this raft for any longer!
Through the Pipes#018.dst: Abre esa compuerta como sea. ¡No quiero seguir más en esta balsa!

Through the Pipes#020.src: Huh, this isn't- really what I expected.
Through the Pipes#020.dst: Vaya, esto no es- lo que esperaba.

Through the Pipes#021.src: Are you sure you want to reset your raft?

Through the Pipes#022.src: Maybe there's something you could build to get across...
Through the Pipes#022.dst: Quizá puedas construir algo para cruzar...

Through the Pipes#023.src: That looks like enough leaf litter. You should return to the generator to fuel it now.
Through the Pipes#023.dst: Parece hojarasca suficiente. Vuelve al generador para echársela de combustible.

Through the Pipes#025.src: Especially considering how rarely Soosu shows up in public, this festival might be my only opportunity this year...
Through the Pipes#025.dst: Y más teniendo en cuenta lo poco que Soosu aparece en público; esta fiesta puede ser mi única ocasión este año...

Through the Pipes#026.src: You should let Fichu know you're done.
Through the Pipes#026.dst: Avisa a Fichu de que has terminado.

Through the Pipes#027.src: The board crumbles under your step. Maybe there's another way to the other side.
Through the Pipes#027.dst: La tabla se deshace bajo tu pie. Quizá haya otro camino al otro lado.

Through the Pipes#028.src: Talk with the citizen in despair at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Through the Pipes#028.dst: Habla con el ciudadano desesperado en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Through the Pipes#029.src: H-Hey, you! Have you seen a raccoon anywhere?
Through the Pipes#029.dst: ¡E-eh, tú! ¿Has visto un mapache por aquí?
Through the Pipes#029.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#030.src: I spent all my free time making a gift for Soosu, and that devil snatched it from me! It would be a shame if I never got the chance to give it to her...
Through the Pipes#030.dst: ¡Dediqué todo mi tiempo libre a hacer un regalo para Soosu, y ese demonio me lo arrebató! Sería una pena no llegar a dárselo nunca...
Through the Pipes#030.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#031.src: This might be a big ask, but- do you think you could help me?
Through the Pipes#031.dst: Quizá sea mucho pedir, pero- ¿crees que podrías ayudarme?
Through the Pipes#031.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#032.src: Y-You will? I knew there was still some good left in this world!
Through the Pipes#032.dst: ¿D-de verdad? ¡Sabía que aún quedaba algo de bondad en el mundo!
Through the Pipes#032.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#033.src: Right! Last time I saw that raccoon, it was running into an alleyway south of the town center. It can't have gone too far!
Through the Pipes#033.dst: ¡Bien! La última vez que vi al mapache, se metía en un callejón al sur del centro del pueblo. ¡No puede haber ido muy lejos!
Through the Pipes#033.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#034.src: I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#034.dst: Yo también seguiré buscando a ese bobo. ¡Mucha suerte!
Through the Pipes#034.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#035.src: ...I get it. If you change your mind, come and talk with me again.
Through the Pipes#035.dst: ...Lo entiendo. Si cambias de idea, vuelve a hablar conmigo.
Through the Pipes#035.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#036.src: Yes! A raccoon! You've seen them before- surely? They're rampant around here!
Through the Pipes#036.dst: ¡Sí! ¡Un mapache! Los habrás visto antes- ¿no? ¡Aquí están por todas partes!
Through the Pipes#036.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#038.src: You know, those furry gray creatures with the weird striped tails?
Through the Pipes#038.dst: Ya sabes, esos bichos grises y peludos con esa cola a rayas tan rara, ¿no?
Through the Pipes#038.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#039.src: ...I hope you know what a raccoon is.
Through the Pipes#039.dst: ...Espero que sepas qué es un mapache.
Through the Pipes#039.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#041.src: Oh- you're back! Are you able to help me now?
Through the Pipes#041.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#043.src: I really think it would be better if we split up to search, don't you agree?
Through the Pipes#043.dst: Creo de verdad que es mejor buscar por separado, ¿no te parece?
Through the Pipes#043.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#044.src: If you forgot, you should try searching south of the town center. But you do you, I suppose...
Through the Pipes#044.dst: Por si lo has olvidado, busca al sur del centro del pueblo. Pero allá tú, supongo...
Through the Pipes#044.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#047.src: Enter the drainage hole at to continue the search.
Through the Pipes#047.dst: Entra en el desagüe para continuar la búsqueda.

Through the Pipes#048.src: Dive deeper into the sewer network.
Through the Pipes#048.dst: Adéntrate más en la red de alcantarillado.

Through the Pipes#049.dst: Explora más allá de la compuerta.

Through the Pipes#050.src: Find a way to get across the flooded section of the sewer.
Through the Pipes#050.dst: Encuentra la forma de cruzar el tramo inundado de la alcantarilla.

Through the Pipes#051.src: Huh, is there someone down there?

Through the Pipes#053.src: Continue chasing the raccoon through the sewers.
Through the Pipes#053.dst: Sigue persiguiendo al mapache por las alcantarillas.

Through the Pipes#054.src: You aren't getting away from me now!

Through the Pipes#055.src: Encounter a familiar face in the sewers.
Through the Pipes#055.dst: Encuentra una cara conocida en las alcantarillas.

Through the Pipes#056.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#060.src: {u}! You're here! I was wondering where you went!
Through the Pipes#060.dst: ¡{u}! ¡Estás aquí! ¡Me preguntaba dónde te habías metido!
Through the Pipes#060.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#061.src: I've been chasing that raccoon the whole time! What in the world have you been up to?
Through the Pipes#061.dst: ¡Yo llevo todo el rato persiguiendo al mapache! ¿Y tú qué demonios has estado haciendo?
Through the Pipes#061.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#062.src: Whatever. I'm struggling to keep up the chase at this rate. But fortunately, I have just the thing that'll help you!
Through the Pipes#062.dst: Da igual. A este paso no aguanto la persecución. ¡Pero, por suerte, tengo justo lo que te hará falta!
Through the Pipes#062.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#064.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#064.dst: ¡Está roto! ¿Cómo voy a alcanzar a ese granuja así?
Through the Pipes#064.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#065.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#065.dst: ...Puede que todo esto sea una causa perdida. Supongo que puedes intentar arreglarlo, pero no merece la pena.
Through the Pipes#065.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#066.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#066.dst: Yo voy hacia allí, a ver si atrapo a ese bicho. Tú ve por el otro lado; nos veremos pronto.
Through the Pipes#066.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#067.src: Encounter the stranger in the sewers.
Through the Pipes#067.dst: Encuentra al desconocido en las alcantarillas.

Through the Pipes#068.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#073.src: Who are you? What are you doing here?
Through the Pipes#073.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#074.src: Ah, exploring the sewers? That's fun! I've basically been to every corner of {p}'s sewers.
Through the Pipes#074.dst: Ah, ¿explorando las alcantarillas? ¡Qué divertido! Yo he estado en casi cada rincón de las alcantarillas de {p}.
Through the Pipes#074.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#075.src: Say, is there any chance you stumbled upon that raccoon earlier? That pest snatched something of value from me!
Through the Pipes#075.dst: Oye, ¿no te habrás cruzado antes con un mapache? ¡Ese bicho me robó algo muy valioso!
Through the Pipes#075.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#076.src: I was making a gift for Sovereign Soosu, but then that fiend just ran off with it! Horrible, isn't it?
Through the Pipes#076.dst: Estaba haciendo un regalo para la Soberana Soosu, ¡y ese granuja salió corriendo con él! Horrible, ¿verdad?
Through the Pipes#076.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#077.src: Especially with how soon the festival is... I wouldn't want to miss my only opportunity this year!
Through the Pipes#077.dst: Y más con lo cerca que está la fiesta... ¡No quiero perder mi única ocasión de este año!
Through the Pipes#077.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#078.src: I could really use your help, and hey I have just the tool you'll want for exploring the sewers!
Through the Pipes#078.dst: Me vendría muy bien tu ayuda y, oye, ¡tengo justo la herramienta que querrás para explorar las alcantarillas!
Through the Pipes#078.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#080.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#080.dst: ¡Está roto! ¿Cómo voy a alcanzar a ese granuja así?
Through the Pipes#080.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#081.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#081.dst: ...Puede que todo esto sea una causa perdida. Supongo que puedes intentar arreglarlo, pero no merece la pena.
Through the Pipes#081.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#082.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. What's your name... {u}? You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#082.dst: Yo voy hacia allí, a ver si atrapo a ese bicho. ¿Cómo te llamas... {u}? Tú ve por el otro lado; nos veremos pronto.
Through the Pipes#082.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#083.src: Find a safe way past the flooded rail tunnels.
Through the Pipes#083.dst: Encuentra un modo seguro de pasar los túneles ferroviarios inundados.

Through the Pipes#084.src: Whew! I didn't mean to let go-
Through the Pipes#084.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#086.src: Perfect, I know where we are, and there isn't much further that foolish raccoon can run. We could corner it!
Through the Pipes#086.dst: Perfecto, sé dónde estamos, y a ese mapache bobo no le queda mucho por donde huir. ¡Podemos acorralarlo!
Through the Pipes#086.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#087.src: Now, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#087.dst: El problema es que no tengo ni idea de cómo cruzar la siguiente zona. Si no recuerdo mal, está muy inundada.
Through the Pipes#087.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#088.src: {u}! OH NO! I didn't mean to drop that on you
Through the Pipes#088.dst: ¡{u}! ¡AY, NO! No quería tirarte eso encima
Through the Pipes#088.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#089.src: W-why were you standing there? Out of all places?
Through the Pipes#089.dst: ¿P-por qué estabas justo ahí? ¿De todos los sitios?
Through the Pipes#089.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#090.src: ...Okay. You seem to be alright. Sorry, I didn't realize you were standing right there!
Through the Pipes#090.dst: ...Vale. Pareces estar bien. ¡Perdona, no me di cuenta de que estabas justo ahí!
Through the Pipes#090.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#091.src: Alright, at least we're regrouped now. Try not to stand under any more heavy objects, alright?
Through the Pipes#091.dst: Bueno, al menos ya volvemos a estar juntos. Intenta no ponerte debajo de más objetos pesados, ¿vale?
Through the Pipes#091.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#092.src: Moving forward, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#092.dst: De cara a seguir, el problema es que no sé cómo cruzar la siguiente zona. Si no recuerdo mal, está muy inundada.
Through the Pipes#092.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#093.src: You'll need to find some way for us to cross. Too many people have gotten the worst of diseases by wading through that water- eugh.
Through the Pipes#093.dst: Tendrás que buscar la forma de que crucemos. Demasiada gente ha pillado enfermedades horribles vadeando esa agua- puaj.
Through the Pipes#093.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#094.src: Right! Let me know when you figure something out. I'll scout around, never had an excuse to explore this area before!
Through the Pipes#094.dst: ¡Bien! Avísame cuando se te ocurra algo. Yo exploraré por aquí; ¡nunca había tenido una excusa para ver esta zona!
Through the Pipes#094.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#095.src: Huh? What's all this stuff? Did someone forget their construction equipment?
Through the Pipes#095.dst: ¿Eh? ¿Y todo esto? ¿Alguien se ha dejado el material de obra?
Through the Pipes#095.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#096.src: I guess the maintenance crews never bother to pack up their equipment. Maybe you can use this stuff for something.
Through the Pipes#096.dst: Se ve que las cuadrillas de mantenimiento nunca recogen su material. Quizá puedas usar esto para algo.
Through the Pipes#096.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#097.src: Check back in with me when you're done!
Through the Pipes#097.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#098.src: Navigate through the end of the sewer network with Fichu.
Through the Pipes#098.dst: Recorre el final de la red de alcantarillado con Fichu.

Through the Pipes#101.src: I'd appreciate it if you added a seat for me.
Through the Pipes#101.dst: Te agradecería que me pusieras un asiento.
Through the Pipes#101.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#105.src: Bet no one's been here for a while.
Through the Pipes#105.dst: Aquí no viene nadie hace tiempo.
Through the Pipes#105.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#106.src: Wonder where that raccoon is now...
Through the Pipes#106.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#107.src: Soosu needs to see that state of this place...
Through the Pipes#107.dst: Soosu tendría que ver cómo está este sitio...
Through the Pipes#107.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#109.src: What else do you think we'll find?
Through the Pipes#109.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#110.src: I've heard a few stories about this place. Mostly bad ones...
Through the Pipes#110.dst: He oído algunas historias de este sitio. Casi todas malas...
Through the Pipes#110.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#111.src: I hope that raccoon hasn't gone too far...
Through the Pipes#111.dst: Espero que ese mapache no se haya alejado mucho...
Through the Pipes#111.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#114.src: This raft looks fragile, be careful!
Through the Pipes#114.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#116.dst: Creo que has chocado con algo.
Through the Pipes#116.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#119.src: You know what you're doing, right?
Through the Pipes#119.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#121.src: Ah! I almost fell out of my seat.
Through the Pipes#121.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#123.src: Are you even capable of not hitting something?
Through the Pipes#123.dst: ¿Eres capaz de no chocar con nada?
Through the Pipes#123.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#124.src: One more hit and I'm taking over!
Through the Pipes#124.dst: ¡Un golpe más y tomo el mando!
Through the Pipes#124.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#125.src: I don't trust you sailing this thing!
Through the Pipes#125.dst: ¡No me fío de ti al timón!
Through the Pipes#125.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#127.src: It can't possibly be that hard!
Through the Pipes#127.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#128.src: Make sure to be careful, okay?
Through the Pipes#128.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#129.src: No wonder everyone avoids this place...
Through the Pipes#129.dst: Con razón todos evitan este sitio...
Through the Pipes#129.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#131.src: You know where you're going, right?
Through the Pipes#131.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#132.src: When I get that raccoon, oh man...
Through the Pipes#132.dst: Cuando pille a ese mapache, madre mía...
Through the Pipes#132.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#133.src: How long have I even spent chasing that fool...
Through the Pipes#133.dst: ¿Cuánto tiempo llevo ya persiguiendo a ese bobo...?
Through the Pipes#133.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#135.src: Keep an eye out for dangers!
Through the Pipes#135.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#136.src: Make sure we're staying on track.
Through the Pipes#136.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#137.src: Maybe rats are better than raccoons after all.
Through the Pipes#137.dst: Quizá las ratas sean mejores que los mapaches, después de todo.
Through the Pipes#137.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#138.src: I regret getting on this raft.
Through the Pipes#138.dst: Me arrepiento de subir a esta balsa.
Through the Pipes#138.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#139.dst: Por favor, no hagas ninguna tontería...
Through the Pipes#139.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#142.src: I cannot wait to get off...
Through the Pipes#142.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#144.src: I really don't want to insult you, but-
Through the Pipes#144.dst: No quiero ofenderte, de verdad, pero-
Through the Pipes#144.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#147.dst: La peor decisión de mi vida...
Through the Pipes#147.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#150.src: Ah! What will we do now?!
Through the Pipes#150.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#152.src: Hmm, is the raft broken? We haven't moved for a while.
Through the Pipes#152.dst: Mmm, ¿se ha roto la balsa? Llevamos un rato sin movernos.
Through the Pipes#152.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#153.src: Are you... going to have us move?
Through the Pipes#153.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#156.src: I'm not sure why you think this place is interesting enough to stop at.
Through the Pipes#156.dst: No sé por qué te parece que este sitio merezca una parada.
Through the Pipes#156.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#160.src: The raccoon is probably long gone at this point, thanks to your delay.
Through the Pipes#160.dst: A estas alturas el mapache ya estará lejísimos, gracias a tu tardanza.
Through the Pipes#160.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#161.dst: Genial, ya nos movemos otra vez.
Through the Pipes#161.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#163.src: How long were we waiting for?
Through the Pipes#163.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#164.src: Huh? What are you doing with that?!
Through the Pipes#164.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#165.src: You're going to sink us with that!
Through the Pipes#165.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#167.src: IS THAT AN EXPLOSIVE?! ARE YOU MAD!
Through the Pipes#167.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#168.src: HELP US! WE'RE GOING TO DROWN!
Through the Pipes#168.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#169.src: OH NO! GET ME OFF OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#169.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#172.src: Why did you think this was a good idea?!
Through the Pipes#172.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#173.src: I gotta get off of this thing!
Through the Pipes#173.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#174.src: That's the exit! Go past this gate, then I never want to board anything sailed by you again!
Through the Pipes#174.dst: ¡Esa es la salida! ¡Cruza esta compuerta y no vuelvo a subirme a nada que pilotes tú!

Through the Pipes#175.src: I gotta get off this thing!
Through the Pipes#175.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#176.src: Hey- maybe we should've been a bit further away from that train?
Through the Pipes#176.dst: Oye- ¿no deberíamos habernos apartado un poco más de ese tren?
Through the Pipes#176.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#179.src: Agh! Sorry, just got scared by that.
Through the Pipes#179.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#180.src: AHHHHH! THIS WAS A HORRIBLE IDEA!
Through the Pipes#180.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#181.src: OUT OF ALL ROUTES YOU TOOK, ONE OF THEM INCLUDED A TRAIN!
Through the Pipes#181.dst: ¡DE TODAS LAS RUTAS, HAS COGIDO LA QUE TIENE UN TREN!
Through the Pipes#181.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#183.src: Huh? AH! THERE'S A TRAIN! GET OUT OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#183.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#186.src: YOU REALLY THINK THIS FLIMSY RAFT IS GOING TO SURVIVE A TRAIN?!
Through the Pipes#186.dst: ¡¿DE VERDAD CREES QUE ESTA BALSA CUTRE AGUANTA UN TREN?!
Through the Pipes#186.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#187.src: YOU FOOL! We barely missed being hit!
Through the Pipes#187.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#188.src: Oh my- we survived! YOU ARE AN IDIOT! DON'T DO THAT AGAIN!
Through the Pipes#188.dst: Madre mía- ¡seguimos vivos! ¡ERES UN IDIOTA! ¡NO LO VUELVAS A HACER!
Through the Pipes#188.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#189.src: This looks like the halfway point!
Through the Pipes#189.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#190.src: You'll need to find a way to open that gate, since I don't see any other way past.
Through the Pipes#190.dst: Tendrás que buscar cómo abrir esa compuerta, porque no veo otra forma de pasar.
Through the Pipes#190.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#191.src: If I'm remembering correctly, just past this gate should be our destination!
Through the Pipes#191.dst: Si no recuerdo mal, ¡justo pasada esta compuerta está nuestro destino!
Through the Pipes#191.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#192.src: Phew, we survived. That was a bit rough, but at least we made it.
Through the Pipes#192.dst: Uf, hemos sobrevivido. Ha sido un poco duro, pero al menos llegamos.
Through the Pipes#192.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#193.src: However, I think I'll definitely be avoiding boats for now...
Through the Pipes#193.dst: Eso sí, creo que voy a evitar los barcos por una temporada...
Through the Pipes#193.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#194.src: We made it! You did a pretty good job navigating, I knew I could trust you!
Through the Pipes#194.dst: ¡Lo logramos! Has pilotado bastante bien, ¡sabía que podía confiar en ti!
Through the Pipes#194.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#195.src: Alright, let's chase down that raccoon once and for all!
Through the Pipes#195.dst: ¡Vamos, a por ese mapache de una vez por todas!
Through the Pipes#195.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#196.src: I hope my prediction is right, and there really is no further it can run from here.
Through the Pipes#196.dst: Espero acertar y que de aquí en adelante no tenga adónde huir.
Through the Pipes#196.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#198.src: Huh?! LOOK! It's the raccoon, that's it!
Through the Pipes#198.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#201.src: Ah ha! Now you're cornered, you little imp!
Through the Pipes#201.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#202.src: Before you do anything, we need a way to take the gift back!
Through the Pipes#202.dst: Antes de hacer nada, ¡necesitamos la forma de recuperar el regalo!
Through the Pipes#202.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#204.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#204.dst: ¡Y mira! ¡Por fin recuperamos el regalo! Sabía que podíamos.
Through the Pipes#204.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#205.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#205.dst: Ojalá siga de una pieza después de todo eso...
Through the Pipes#205.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#206.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#206.dst: ¡Ha sobrevivido! ¡Gracias a la reina! No sé qué habría hecho si no...
Through the Pipes#206.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#207.src: {u}, from the very start, you have been a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#207.dst: {u}, desde el principio has sido una ayuda enorme. ¡No sé cómo agradecerte tu esfuerzo!
Through the Pipes#207.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#208.src: ...You don't think that was a little too brutal, do you?
Through the Pipes#208.dst: ...No te parecerá que eso ha sido un poco bestia, ¿no?

Through the Pipes#209.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#209.dst: {u}, desde el principio fuiste una ayuda enorme. ¡No sé cómo agradecerte tu esfuerzo!
Through the Pipes#209.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#210.src: Without your help, I don't even know if I could have caught that raccoon on my own!
Through the Pipes#210.dst: ¡Sin tu ayuda ni sé si habría podido atrapar a ese mapache yo solo!
Through the Pipes#210.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#211.src: As a reward, I have an extra gift just for you! Thank you again for your incredible help!
Through the Pipes#211.dst: ¡Como recompensa, tengo un regalo extra solo para ti! ¡Gracias otra vez por tu increíble ayuda!
Through the Pipes#211.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#212.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#212.dst: ¡Y mira! ¡Por fin recuperamos el regalo! Sabía que podíamos.
Through the Pipes#212.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#213.dst: Ojalá siga de una pieza después de todo eso...
Through the Pipes#213.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#214.dst: ¡Ha sobrevivido! ¡Gracias a la reina! No sé qué habría hecho si no...
Through the Pipes#214.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#215.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#215.dst: {u}, desde el principio fuiste una ayuda enorme. ¡No sé cómo agradecerte tu esfuerzo!
Through the Pipes#215.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#216.src: Not only did you safely get us through a flooded tunnel with that creation of yours, but you came more prepared than I could have expected!
Through the Pipes#216.dst: No solo nos cruzaste sanos y salvos un túnel inundado con ese invento tuyo, ¡es que venías mejor preparado de lo que imaginaba!
Through the Pipes#216.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#217.src: A cage... a ring to use as a distraction... and even a firecracker. Where did you even find all this stuff?
Through the Pipes#217.dst: Una jaula... un anillo para distraerlo... y hasta un petardo. ¿De dónde has sacado todo esto?
Through the Pipes#217.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#218.src: And on top of all of that, you found my art supplies bag! That bag itself is more important to me than the gift we were chasing after!
Through the Pipes#218.dst: ¡Y encima encontraste mi bolsa de material de pintura! ¡Esa bolsa me importa más que el regalo que perseguíamos!
Through the Pipes#218.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#219.src: Speaking of that, I would like to give you Soosu's gift as a token of appreciation. I believe you're more deserving of it.
Through the Pipes#219.dst: Y hablando de eso, quiero darte el regalo de Soosu en señal de agradecimiento. Creo que tú lo mereces más.
Through the Pipes#219.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#220.src: Don't worry, I've already brainstormed a better design. I think Soosu will like this next one even more!
Through the Pipes#220.dst: Tranquilo, ya tengo pensado un diseño mejor. ¡Creo que a Soosu le gustará aún más el siguiente!
Through the Pipes#220.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#221.src: Don't go so close! You might scare it off again!
Through the Pipes#221.dst: ¡No te acerques tanto! ¡Podrías espantarlo otra vez!
Through the Pipes#221.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#222.src: Thank you again for the help! I couldn't have done it without you.
Through the Pipes#222.dst: ¡Gracias de nuevo por la ayuda! Sin ti no habría podido.
Through the Pipes#222.speaker: Fichu
